# Upgrade to Prisma ORM 7

Honest caveats: this guide does not apply to MongoDB projects — Prisma 7 has no MongoDB connector, so those projects should stay on v6 or go to Prisma 8 instead; upgrades require Node.js 20.19.0+ and TypeScript 5.4.0+; this is a high-touch migration, so run `prisma generate` and test before treating it as done. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
